0022600127.text: The Nuggets (0-1, fifth in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, 12th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (0-2, third in the Pacific, 2 games back, 13th in the West) in a regular season game, with both teams still seeking their first win of 2026-27. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (wrist), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Golden State is without Al Horford (back), Brandin Podziemski (back), Draymond Green (back), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Denver won the most recent meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026, though they have not yet met this season.
